description: ‘Higher Self’ is produced by myself and Dougie Stu (who you may remember from ‘Centred’ on my FIELDNOTES PT II EP that came out last year). We made this song in LA last April and it was such a fun one to make! It's about self-love, and the way I imagine my higher self engages and speaks with me, challenging all the thoughts I have about being hard to love. It’s a mantra of sorts that I hope will stick with you.
